question: The value of (0.1 × 0.001 × 0.0001 × 10⁶) is:
solution:
**Given:**

(0.1 × 0.001 × 0.0001 × 10⁶)

**Formula used:**

xa × xb = xa⁺b

**Calculations:**

0.1 = 10−¹

0.001 = 10−³

0.0001 = 10−⁴

Value = 10−¹ × 10−³ × 10−⁴ × 10⁶

⇒ Value = 10⁽−¹ − ³ − ⁴ ⁺ ⁶⁾

⇒ Value = 10−²

⇒ Value = 1/10²

⇒ Value = 1/100

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
